subject: Architecture
title: The Great Wall: Not One Wall but Many
description: A 60-second lesson on The Great Wall: Not One Wall but Many.

hook.text: The Great Wall stretches over 13,000 miles, but most of it is crumbling rubble, not stone.

buildup.text: Different dynasties built different sections over 2,000 years using mud, wood, and brick.

discovery.text: The famous stone wall tourists visit was built by the Ming Dynasty — the most recent version.

twist.text: It failed militarily multiple times. The Mongols simply bribed guards or walked around it.

climax.text: The wall worked better as a trade route and communication network than a defensive barrier.

punchline.text: History's biggest wall was beaten by a bribe.

quiz.question: Which dynasty built the famous stone sections tourists visit today?
